R7AH-grouse-walk-0002.name: 170 m NE of Cypress Creek
R7AH-grouse-walk-0002.pressureWhy: More than 5 km from a drivable road (estimate).
R7AH-grouse-walk-0002.parkWhat: pull off on an unnamed gravel road

evidence.t: Trail: North West Mounted Police Trail, 5.0 km stretch.
100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (BWBS, CWH, ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
20 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.

flags.t: MU (Management Unit) 7-57, Region 7B Omineca. Near the MU line: check the MU map.
Route enters a Motor Vehicle Closed Area: Peace Alpine. Closed Year Round. Synopsis map 1-37b/24.
Spot is inside a Motor Vehicle Closed Area: Muskwa-Kechika Access Management Area. Closed Year Round. Synopsis map 1-114/26.

seasonRows.notes: MU 7-57 is not listed in the Region 7B sharp tailed grouse rows (my reading of the table).

plan: Drive: from Germansen Landing, about 219 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 56.98781, -123.05419, pull off on an unnamed gravel road. Map links below.
Walk 17 km to the start. Walk: the North West Mounted Police Trail stretch, 5.0 km one way. About 100 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-57, Region 7B. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2024-07-09, closures 2026-10-16.
R7AH-grouse-walk-0002.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 7-57: about 1,515 hunter days a year for all big game (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.60 days per square km, middle third of BC MUs; access: more than 5 km from a drivable road. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).
